game_title: Patrol Decision Tree – Lighthouse Point Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Coastal Port – Lighthouse Point, the lighthouse on the point: the harbor master must handle rogue waves while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Patrol Decision Tree: Program a guard-evasion decision tree using nested conditions.
theme: Coastal Port – Lighthouse Point: the lighthouse on the point
core_gameplay_loop: In Lighthouse Point, repeat each round: Program a guard-evasion decision tree using nested conditions. Each round, rogue waves strike the harbor gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the cover value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the harbor gate from rogue waves in Lighthouse Point: keep the cover meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 26-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: cover drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 26-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 2 (intro tier): Patrol Decision Tree
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how cover changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue waves in Lighthouse Point.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 26 seconds while cover > 0.
